scenes.say: Scammers plant fake bank helplines on Google, and people call them. [[0.3]] Helpline Watch finds them first.

card.title: Fake helplines, found before the call.

scenes.say: India has logged one point seven three lakh complaints, and twenty-one hundred crore rupees lost, to fake customer-care numbers found on Google. [[0.3]] The fraud team googles from one desk. The victim in Patna sees a different page.

card.label: lost in India to fake customer-care numbers found on Google
card.sub: 1.73 lakh complaints. The analyst searches from one desk and never sees the victim's page.

scenes.say: Helpline Watch searches Google the way victims do, from every Indian city you choose, then marks every number that isn't the brand's. [[0.3]] Let's sweep Zomato, which publishes no phone number at all.

Twenty-eight searches from five cities: results, the answer box, People also ask, the local pack, Maps, and ads, each made through SerpApi's location parameter. [[0.4]] Eight fakes, from Google as it is today. And here's the surprise: five of them sit on zomato.com itself. Restaurant listings named to rank for customer care, each carrying a personal mobile.

Every verdict explains itself. [[0.3]] Named signals: not one of Zomato's numbers, a personal mobile presented as customer care, and a page on Zomato's own domain that is not about Zomato. No language model anywhere. And every sighting keeps its SerpApi link, so anyone can replay the search.

Across brands, the graph joins every number seen for more than one brand. [[0.3]] On the three seeded demo brands, one mobile is sold as three helplines at once. That's one operation, not three coincidences.

It doesn't cry wolf. [[0.3]] Switch to HDFC Bank: the real eighteen-hundred sixteen-hundred gets a green tick wherever an aggregator republishes it, and numbers on the bank's own site go to the list, not to takedown. Only an unclaimed branch listing with a personal mobile is flagged.

The output is a takedown pack: a CSV, evidence with a SerpApi replay link for every sighting, the right Google form per surface, and a complaint template for the cybercrime portal. [[0.3]] A person keeps or removes every number first.

SerpApi's Autocomplete plans the queries victims type. Search, Maps and the Ads Transparency Center return each city's page. Deterministic signals score every number, and the pack holds only what the analyst keeps.
